DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma of the Head.

The "double duct sign" (dilation of both the pancreatic and bile ducts) combined with a 5.3 cm hypodense mass in the pancreatic head, severe weight loss, and your history of heavy smoking is diagnostic for pancreatic cancer obstructing the biliary tree. This explains your jaundice, pale stools, dark urine, and pruritus.
